responsibility: Implements the rs6000 RTL pass for PC-relative linker relaxation of external variable accesses. It scans basic blocks for prefixed PCREL_GOT address loads that have exactly one safe load or store use, verifies with DF use-def chains and instruction-type checks that no intervening operation invalidates the transformation, then rewrites the pair into synthetic PCREL_OPT UNSPEC forms and labels defined in pcrel-opt.md so the assembler/linker can relax two-instruction GOT-based accesses into single prefixed PC-relative loads or stores when possible.
